what: Agents in flight, and why. A finished agent is REMOVED from this file, not marked done — the page shows what is happening now, and history lives in git.

agents.what: Stop calling guarantees grants, and stop offering funds that are not funds
agents.why: One transposed letter in a lookup table has been recording every guarantee scheme as a grant. Italy's largest — €14.9 billion, 13,892 awards — is shown to founders as a grant, while founders who ask for a guarantee are never shown it. Separately, eleven rows a founder can be offered are not funds at all but accounting labels: Poland's entire list is eight of them, so a Polish founder is currently shown nothing real.

agents.what: Find out what the silent funds actually are
agents.why: Rows that say nothing halved this week; the rest turned out not to be a display problem. Checking them one by one against the funders' own pages — and so far most are not fundable: Norway's forty-nine are either accounting codes or retired programmes, and none can be applied to today.
